title: Protected executable registry
objective: Replace the single-executable public process ceiling with a STRONG-gated local registry of protected executables so everyday build and test tools can run through the existing argv-only, contained, network-less, bounded, per-run-approved process path, with executable identity bound to canonical path, content hash, size, and file identity re-verified immediately before every launch, a per-entry argv grammar, and shells, script hosts, interpreters, and script files denied outright.

include: integrity-checked protected-state registry of executables with canonical path, SHA-256, size, file identity, allowed first-argument subcommands, and denied flags
registry changes only through a local STRONG-gated command, never through MCP or a remote context
hard denial of shells, script hosts, interpreters, package-runner scripts, and script or shortcut file types regardless of registration
process.spawn admitting only registered executables whose identity and content still match, re-verified immediately before launch, with argv constrained by the entry grammar
retention of argv-only execution, workspace-relative cwd, AppContainer containment, NONE network class, timeouts, output bounds, descendant containment, and fresh per-run approval
discoverability of registered executable identifiers through existing read-only status without a schema change
exclude: `run_anything`, unrestricted shell, unrestricted PowerShell, unrestricted cmd, or arbitrary executable paths
interpreter or script-engine execution of any kind
background or detached processes, stdin interaction, or network access for spawned processes
any new MCP tool or schema change
filesystem mutation, browser, desktop, clipboard, or network exposure (SG-000061 through SG-000064)

authority_delta.filesystem: None beyond the cotrad-owned registry file under protected state.
authority_delta.process: process.spawn may launch locally registered, hash-pinned, non-interpreter executables with constrained argv inside the existing containment.
authority_delta.network: None; spawned processes keep the NONE network class.
authority_delta.approval: Registry changes require STRONG local presence; every launch keeps its per-run approval.
authority_delta.privileged: Registry management is a local PRIVILEGED operation never exposed as an MCP tool.

invariants: no unrestricted shell, PowerShell, cmd, interpreter, or arbitrary executable path
a modified registered executable fails closed
an agent or remote client can never change the registry

acceptance.claim: Registered, hash-pinned executables run through the existing contained, bounded, approved process path with argv constrained by their grammar, and unregistered, modified, interpreter, shell, and script targets fail closed.
Registry changes require STRONG local presence and are unreachable from MCP and remote contexts, and the registry fails closed when missing, corrupt, or tampered.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000061: Filesystem mutation exposure may proceed only after SG-000060 closes.

done_when: The protected executable registry is canonical with STRONG-gated management, hash-pinned identity, argv grammars, interpreter denial, and the existing process containment unchanged.
